titleA:
Edit the provided original HeavyMach title artwork by OUTPAINTING LEFT AND RIGHT. Produce an ultra-wide 3:1 landscape canvas (ideally 1536x512). Original painting: gritty muted olive and ochre ruined city, painterly military science fiction, hot orange gunfire on the left, dark ruined steel and rubble on the right. Match horizon, perspective, fog, brushwork, restrained detail density and light at both seams. Extend ruined buildings, smoke, ground rubble only. Do not add tanks, characters, aircraft, weapons, lettering, UI, borders or logos. The original tank silhouette, firing barrel and center scene must remain recognizable and in exactly the same centered rectangle. Keep new outer scenery subdued so title UI remains readable. No stretching the existing image. Output only the extended artwork.
Candidate A: continue the existing skyline and rubble with subtle atmospheric depth, maintaining its warm left light and dark right silhouettes.
